method: Unprofiled source-mode physical typing at 5 Hz measures actual character_due event to the first physical ACK containing that character. Scheduling delay is separate. Single runs are not latency distributions. Diagnostic phase/stack attribution includes observers and preserves 8192-step boundaries; method timers are inclusive and overlapping. Offscreen compositor replay is a separate matched-pixel comparison.

diagnostic_before.method: Signals bracket actual first send_text through observation of its complete offer. Sampling occurs at unchanged 8192-step owner boundaries; start/stop resolution is one boundary plus signal delivery. Packed phase transitions are separate; guest stacks use existing suspension snapshots. Method timers are inclusive and must not be added together. Wall times include observer cost and are not latency benchmarks.

diagnostic_before.word_table_selection: Top 80 inclusive and leaf words by sampled steps, plus named service/ownership checks; full groups remain in the hashed raw artifact.
diagnostic_before.counter_limitation: This initial observer re-read cumulative native counters at shutdown after stopping its samples. Discard raw top-level native_delta, native_profile_delta and native_exits: they include later idle work. Sampled groups, interval counters and inclusive method timers stop correctly; comparisons use those groups. The final observer freezes cumulative counters at the same stop boundary.

compositor_replay.method: Seven actual source-mode Desktop typing offers, four alternating compositions per implementation. Median omits first trial. Same CELL cache behavior and fonts; every composition compared for exact RGBA pixel digest and structural hit-map equality. Offscreen replay, not physical latency.
